description: Template for a hand-labeled retrieval eval. Copy next to your graphify-out/, replace the queries with real questions from your own sessions, and run: paragraph retrieve --eval <this file>. Each query lists what should rank in the top 10 (expected_*) and what should NOT despite keyword similarity (negative_nodes).
changelog: v1: initial labels. Rule: never silently relabel old queries — bump the version and document the rationale here.
